info.name: Get A List Of Data Deletion Rules

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of deletion Rules returned in the response

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

items.docs: Get a list of data deletion rules in the organization. The response is paginated with a default limit of 50 rules.

info.name: Create A New Data Deletion Rule

items.docs: Create a new data deletion rule to delete logs.

info.name: Get Data Deletion Rule Information For The Given Id.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the Deletion Rule to fetch

items.docs: Get Data Deletion Rule information for the given Id with updated fields.

info.name: Cancel The Data Deletion Rule With The Given Id.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the Deletion Rule to cancel

items.docs: Cancel the data Deletion Rule with the given Id. Allowed only if the rule is waiting for approval.

info.name: Delete The Data Deletion Rule With The Given Id.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the Deletion Rule to delete

items.docs: Delete the data Deletion Rule with the given Id. Allowed only if the rule is cancelled.
